extraction.unit: exact labelled section, not clinical entity or NLP accuracy

support.limitation: Synthetic technical traceability only; clinical correctness and source currency not evaluated

automatic_grounding.criteria: Determinism, observation-order invariance, no input mutation, resolution of source/version/locator

model_coverage.limitation: Structural presence and example coverage, not semantic/clinical completeness or full requirements acceptance

extension.limitation: Does not prove arbitrary scoring, medicine registration, alert-rule or new feature extensibility

catalog_experiments.limitation: Warning generation only; not arbitrary clinical alert conditions or external delivery
